rowText: On-Deck: run Asks until a model emits a bare <bonsai-status>Sure.</bonsai-status> (small models do this) -- the italic line must keep showing something, never disappear mid-Ask and leave a bare spinner.

steps.press: sampled the status line during the long battery-life ask
steps.expected: a readable status line at every sample, never a bare/empty spinner
steps.landing: status text read "Thinking" then reasoning prose ("Since the user asked about performance/power, I need to address the power aspect...")

verdictSentence: Every time the status line was sampled it showed real words -- either "Thinking" or the model's own reasoning text -- never a blank line; no bare <bonsai-status>Sure.</bonsai-status> tag happened to show up on these particular questions, so the specific failure mode this row hunts for was not exercised tonight, only its opposite (a line that stayed readable) was confirmed.
